Here's the breakdown for the first payment:

First month: AED 7,000
Last month deposit: AED 7,000
Security deposit: AED 1,500 (fully refundable within 14 working days after check-out)

Total to start: AED 15,500

To confirm everything, we just need your passport copy and email to send the payment link. What's your planned move-in date?
